sections_reviewed: Section 3 (pp. 4–5): graph dynamics, stochastic latent prior/posterior, imagination and observation correction
verified_title: Beyond Static Graph World Models: Learning Stochastic Latent Dynamics over Evolving Topologies
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2609.28670: Beyond Static Graph World Models: Learning Stochastic Latent Dynamics over Evolving Topologies
method_summary: Graph Dynamics Model combines sparse recurrent adjacency, message passing and RSSM-style stochastic latent dynamics. It models evolving topology and node features with a prediction prior and observation-corrected posterior, together with reward, continuation and action-mask heads.
direct_overlap: dynamic graph plus stochastic recurrent world model
evidence_and_limits: Generic graph environments, not a direct Wi-Fi warehouse result. The paper also points to G-RSSM for ad-hoc network dynamics; that additional citation was not independently reviewed here.
